caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing male figure positioned on a pinkish-red rectangular pedestal with small round feet. The figure has dark brown skin and wears a red tunic with yellow and gold trim and a matching sash, along with green and gold details on the sleeves. He has on beige leggings and dark shoes. The figure is adorned with a decorative collar and a medallion necklace. He wears a large, elaborate headdress with red, yellow, green, and black feathers. The figure holds a bundle in his left hand, and his right hand is partially clenched. There is a small, ornate green and gold apron covering the front of the tunic. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and the artist's signature, "Eugene Croe," is present in the bottom right corner.
title: Cigar Store Indian
